evals.prompt: I've already run the site-audit on astrazeneca.com and have the gap-analysis ready. Now I need to extract the design tokens from the source site and update my EDS styles to match. The homepage URL is https://www.astrazeneca.com/. This is a fresh EDS boilerplate — only the default roboto fonts and boilerplate colors are set.
evals.expected_output: Updated styles/styles.css with AstraZeneca's brand colors, typography (lexia serif headings, sans-serif body), and spacing. Updated styles/fonts.css with @font-face for the AZ web fonts. Font files copied to fonts/. A design-tokens.md report at .specify/migration/design-tokens.md.
expectations: The extraction script runs successfully and produces .specify/migration/tokens/tokens.json
tokens.json contains a colors object with at least body_bg, body_text, link, light, and dark keys
tokens.json contains a typography object with body and headings sections
tokens.json contains a fonts array or fontFaces array with at least one entry
tokens.json contains a palette array with at least 10 color entries
styles/styles.css :root block is updated with new color values (not the boilerplate defaults)
styles/styles.css :root contains --background-color, --text-color, --link-color, --link-hover-color
styles/styles.css :root contains --body-font-family and --heading-font-family with non-roboto values
styles/styles.css :root contains heading sizes (--heading-font-size-xxl through --heading-font-size-xs)
styles/styles.css contains @font-face fallback declarations with size-adjust
styles/fonts.css contains @font-face declarations with font-display: swap
styles/fonts.css references font files in ../fonts/ directory
At least one .woff2 font file exists in the fonts/ directory
.specify/migration/design-tokens.md exists and contains a Token Mapping table
.specify/migration/design-tokens.md contains a Color Palette section
.specify/migration/design-tokens.md contains a Font Inventory section
The CSS passes npm run lint without new errors introduced by the token changes

evals.prompt: Extract the design tokens from https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ and apply them to my EDS project. I want the styles to match Mozilla's visual identity. No site-audit has been run — just do the token extraction directly.
evals.expected_output: Updated styles/styles.css and styles/fonts.css with Mozilla's brand tokens. Mozilla uses a distinctive typography and color scheme. The design-tokens.md report should document the mapping decisions.
expectations: The extraction script runs and produces tokens.json in the output directory
styles/styles.css :root is updated with color values different from the boilerplate defaults
styles/styles.css :root --body-font-family is updated (not roboto)
styles/styles.css :root --heading-font-family is updated (not roboto-condensed)
styles/styles.css contains heading font size tokens for at least xxl, xl, l, m
styles/fonts.css is updated with @font-face declarations
A design-tokens.md report exists with Token Mapping and Decisions Log sections
The --nav-height token is updated based on the extracted nav height

evals.prompt: I need to match the visual style of https://developer.chrome.com/ for my EDS project. Extract design tokens — colors, fonts, sizes, spacing — and update my styles. This site probably uses Google Fonts so licensing should be straightforward.
evals.expected_output: Updated EDS style files matching Chrome Developer site's clean, modern aesthetic. Google Fonts should be self-hosted with proper @font-face. Design tokens report documents all decisions.
expectations: tokens.json is produced with color palette and typography data
styles/styles.css :root updated with new color tokens
styles/styles.css :root --body-font-family reflects the source site's body font
styles/styles.css contains --heading-font-size-xxl through at least --heading-font-size-m
styles/fonts.css contains @font-face declarations
design-tokens.md report exists with at least Token Mapping and Font Inventory sections
The report mentions Google Fonts or notes that font licensing is permissive
